stop.name: Stop timer ring
stop.description: Stops an Assist timer ringing on an ESPHome satellite (e.g. Home Assistant Voice PE). media_player.media_stop does not: the ring plays on the satellite's announcement pipeline.

pause.name: Pause timer
pause.description: Pauses one Assist timer by its id.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id, as listed in sensor.assist_timers.

unpause.name: Resume timer
unpause.description: Resumes one paused Assist timer by its id.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id, as listed in sensor.assist_timers.

not_esphome.message: {entity_id} is not an ESPHome media player (or Home Assistant changed its internals).

timer_not_found.message: Timer {timer_id} not found (it finished or was cancelled).
